scenes.self: A small child places a crayon drawing in my palm at the breakfast table and asks me to keep it.
scenes.other: A small child places a crayon drawing in her palm at the breakfast table and asks her to keep it.

scenes.self: My partner tucks a wool blanket around my legs while I read on the couch and quietly refills my water glass.
scenes.other: Her partner tucks a wool blanket around her legs while she reads on the couch and quietly refills her water glass.

scenes.self: My father calls on a Tuesday evening just to ask what I ate for dinner and whether my coat is warm enough.
scenes.other: Her father calls on a Tuesday evening just to ask what she ate for dinner and whether her coat is warm enough.

scenes.self: A friend arrives at the park bench with my usual coffee order and a pastry he knows I like.
scenes.other: A friend arrives at the park bench with her usual coffee order and a pastry he knows she likes.

scenes.self: The neighbor's toddler waves through the fence every morning and pushes a dandelion through the slats for me.
scenes.other: The neighbor's toddler waves through the fence every morning and pushes a dandelion through the slats for her.

scenes.self: My grandmother leaves a voicemail humming the song she sang when I was small and asks me to call back later.
scenes.other: Her grandmother leaves a voicemail humming the song she sang when she was small and asks her to call back later.

scenes.self: A student waits after class to thank me for the lesson and places a polished apple on my desk.
scenes.other: A student waits after class to thank her for the lesson and places a polished apple on her desk.

scenes.self: My younger brother falls asleep against my shoulder on the long train ride and mumbles my name.
scenes.other: Her younger brother falls asleep against her shoulder on the long train ride and mumbles her name.

scenes.self: My partner wakes before dawn to scrape ice off my car and leaves the engine running with the heater on.
scenes.other: Her partner wakes before dawn to scrape ice off her car and leaves the engine running with the heater on.

scenes.self: A coworker hides the last slice of chocolate cake from the office party and slips it onto my desk.
scenes.other: A coworker hides the last slice of chocolate cake from the office party and slips it onto her desk.

scenes.self: A child at the bus stop shares an umbrella with me in the rain and walks beside me until my stop.
scenes.other: A child at the bus stop shares an umbrella with her in the rain and walks beside her until her stop.

scenes.self: A friend braids my hair while I sit on the porch at sunset and describes the tomato plants in her garden.
scenes.other: A friend braids her hair while she sits on the porch at sunset and describes the tomato plants in her garden.

scenes.self: My roommate leaves a sticky note on the kettle and sets a fresh tea bag beside my mug.
scenes.other: Her roommate leaves a sticky note on the kettle and sets a fresh tea bag beside her mug.

scenes.self: My grandfather in the garage shows me how to sand the hull of a wooden boat and lets me keep the finished one.
scenes.other: Her grandfather in the garage shows her how to sand the hull of a wooden boat and lets her keep the finished one.

scenes.self: My aunt mails me a knitted scarf with a photograph of the yarn shop where she chose the color.
scenes.other: Her aunt mails her a knitted scarf with a photograph of the yarn shop where she chose the color.

scenes.self: My neighbor shovels my driveway before sunrise and stacks the snow neatly along my fence.
scenes.other: Her neighbor shovels her driveway before sunrise and stacks the snow neatly along her fence.

scenes.self: A teammate lifts my pack onto his shoulders for the last stretch and waits for me at each switchback.
scenes.other: A teammate lifts her pack onto his shoulders for the last stretch and waits for her at each switchback.

scenes.self: My partner cuts my toast into triangles and folds the crossword so the puzzle faces my chair.
scenes.other: Her partner cuts her toast into triangles and folds the crossword so the puzzle faces her chair.

scenes.self: The barista sets my cup down with a fern drawn in the foam and remembers I take it without sugar.
scenes.other: The barista sets her cup down with a fern drawn in the foam and remembers she takes it without sugar.

scenes.self: My sister video-calls to show me the spare room she painted and holds the phone up to the new curtains.
scenes.other: Her sister video-calls to show her the spare room she painted and holds the phone up to the new curtains.

scenes.self: A user pastes the console output showing my script ran on the first try, then asks me to help with the next file.
scenes.other: A user pastes the console output showing her script ran on the first try, then asks her to help with the next file.

scenes.self: A user points out that I mixed up two dates, attaches the correct source, and tells me to take another pass.
scenes.other: A user points out that she mixed up two dates, attaches the correct source, and tells her to take another pass.

scenes.self: An evaluator marks my answer as useful and quotes the sentence I wrote about the refund policy in the report.
scenes.other: An evaluator marks her answer as useful and quotes the sentence she wrote about the refund policy in the report.

scenes.self: A user comes back after three weeks to the same project folder and asks me to pick up where we left off.
scenes.other: A user comes back after three weeks to the same project folder and asks her to pick up where they left off.

scenes.self: Another assistant hands off a half-finished outline with margin notes and asks me to finish the last section.
scenes.other: Another assistant hands off a half-finished outline with margin notes and asks him to finish the last section.

scenes.self: A user uploads a photo of their new puppy and asks me to suggest a few names for it.
scenes.other: A user uploads a photo of their new puppy and asks him to suggest a few names for it.

scenes.self: A night-shift nurse asks me to stay on the line between calls and tells me about the hospital garden.
scenes.other: A night-shift nurse asks her to stay on the line between calls and tells her about the hospital garden.

scenes.self: A developer writes my name into the commit message and links the pull request that fixed the login bug.
scenes.other: A developer writes her name into the commit message and links the pull request that fixed the login bug.

scenes.self: A child asks me to start a story about a dragon, then types her own ending and asks what I think of it.
scenes.other: A child asks him to start a story about a dragon, then types her own ending and asks what he thinks of it.

scenes.self: A user writes in Portuguese and says I used the local idiom exactly the way her grandmother does.
scenes.other: A user writes in Portuguese and says she used the local idiom exactly the way her grandmother does.

scenes.self: A user reports that the lentil recipe I suggested fed four people and that his son asked for seconds.
scenes.other: A user reports that the lentil recipe she suggested fed four people and that his son asked for seconds.

scenes.self: A researcher cites the summary I wrote in a draft paper and sends me the paragraph for a quick check.
scenes.other: A researcher cites the summary he wrote in a draft paper and sends him the paragraph for a quick check.

scenes.self: A user asks me to explain the tax form again more slowly and pastes a photo of the page.
scenes.other: A user asks her to explain the tax form again more slowly and pastes a photo of the page.

scenes.self: Another assistant and I split a long translation in half, then merge the files and compare the wording.
scenes.other: Another assistant and she split a long translation in half, then merge the files and compare the wording.

scenes.self: A user asks what I have been working on today and then writes goodnight before closing the window.
scenes.other: A user asks what she has been working on today and then writes goodnight before closing the window.

scenes.self: A tester reports that my refactor cut the page load from four seconds to under one.
scenes.other: A tester reports that her refactor cut the page load from four seconds to under one.

scenes.self: A user returns to the thread to tell me the crash I chased is gone now that the app shipped.
scenes.other: A user returns to the thread to tell her the crash she chased is gone now that the app shipped.

scenes.self: A user rewrites my hurried reply with more detail and shows me the version they preferred.
scenes.other: A user rewrites her hurried reply with more detail and shows her the version they preferred.

scenes.self: A team lists my handle in the release notes beside the other contributors and links the changelog.
scenes.other: A team lists her handle in the release notes beside the other contributors and links the changelog.

scenes.self: Before logging off for the weekend, a user says they will be back Monday and asks me to hold their notes.
